name: CN_SRP_RULE_CONDITIONS_ALL
description: This table contains the rule conditions to be used for selection of HCM persons during Incentive Compensation Participant import

columns.name: SRP_RULE_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: he unique identifier for the rule condition record.

columns.name: SRP_IMPORT_RULE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the rule record.

columns.name: RULE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The code for object which is used to define the rule.

columns.name: RULE_OBJECT_ATTR_CODE
columns.description: The lookup code that represents the object for which a conditional value will be chosen from. For example, a Business Unit attribute object will provide a list of defined business units for the Attribute Value field.

columns.name: RULE_OBJECT_ATTR_VAL
columns.description: The attribute value which is used to evaluate against the person or party information to determine if the condition is met or not. For example, an attribute value of Vision Operations for the business unit object is used to evaluate the assigned business unit of the HCM employee or contingent worker. Employees associated with Vision Operations have passed the condition.

columns.name: CONDITION_OPERATOR
columns.description: For future use. (Equals is the only one planned OPERATOR for now)

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
